_comment: Tool registry of dwo-Forge. tool: lens (analysis lines), statemonitor (DwoStateMonitor), canvas (DwoCanvas), forge (shared operations). kind: build = implemented by dwo-Forge, wrap = Epic/engine tool driven headless, ai = interpretation. status: ready | planned.

tools.invocation: Tarjan SCC on module and asset hard-reference graphs
reachability from maps and Config/*.ini; replaces UI-only or paid cleaners
ObjectRedirector detection (fix-up stays manual; ResavePackages would modify packages)
node count, branches, longest exec chain per graph
UE5 style guide prefixes and folder rules from config (Allar Linter has no confirmed UE5 support)
detects the project's DwoStateMonitor (or 1.x StateMonitor) plugin, BP and C++ submit points; adds StateMonitor.* tests to verify
lens_logs.py: severity, category, fingerprint groups, new-vs-baseline

tools.description: Boots every map (or config smoke.maps) in -game -nullrhi for a fixed time and gates on fatal, crash, ensure and error counts.
tools.invocation: UnrealEditor-Cmd <uproject> <map> -game -nullrhi -nosound -unattended -log -ABSLOG=<file>, stopped after smoke.seconds; logs parsed by lens_logs

tools.description: Captures N frames with the CSV profiler on one map and reports FrameTime / thread time percentiles, hitches and a frame-time series against a budget.
tools.invocation: UnrealEditor <uproject> <map> -game -windowed -csvCompression=0 -ExitAfterCsvProfiling -ExecCmds="csvprofile startfile=<id>.csv,csvprofile exitoncompletion,csvprofile frames=N"; Saved/Profiling/CSV parsed by lens_runtime.py

tools.description: Content size by asset, folder and file type, plus hard-reference load weight per asset from the latest analyze graph. No engine needed.
tools.invocation: scans Content/*.uasset|umap|uexp|ubulk; closure over AssetHardRef edges in graph.json

tools.description: Records an Unreal Insights trace of the running game for a fixed time.
Starts the game detached (windowed 1280x720) and prints its pid; used by the GUI to stream to the StateMonitor viewer.

tools.invocation: Engine/Binaries/DotNET/CsvTools/PerfreportTool -csv <perf.csv> -o <out> (HTML report on top of the perf line)
UBT <Target> Win64 Development -StaticAnalyzer=VisualCpp (nightly, code projects only)
dwo-Forge GUI > DwoStateMonitor > 녹화 저장 / 녹화 열기 (or --open-recording <file.jsonl>)
tools.description: Records every live snapshot the viewer receives and saves or reopens it as JSON Lines; the timeline replays it.

tools.invocation: Context Packet from graph.json + findings, unknown relations only
dwo-Forge.bat (repository) or __dwo-forge.bat gui; Dear ImGui docking + DirectX 11, built once with MSVC
tools.output: Lens (dashboard, architecture, problems, verify, logs, performance), DwoStateMonitor live view, DwoCanvas, history, tools

tools.description: Live viewer for running games: object graph with ownership and references, per-field state machines with transition counts, property inspector, scrubbable timeline and event list.
tools.invocation: DwoStateMonitor plugin connects to 127.0.0.1:47731 (JSON Lines protocol v1); zero-code auto-observe of GameMode, GameState, players, pawns and components

tools.description: Compares two runs of the same line: metric deltas, new and resolved problems, tests whose result changed.
tools.invocation: GUI > 실행 기록, check two runs

tools.description: Per-test result strip over the last 10 verify runs; flags new failures and flaky tests (both pass and fail recently).
Merges findings, quality, test failures, log groups, smoke, perf and size issues from every line's latest run; marks NEW against the previous run and lets you mute items into a per-project baseline.

tools.invocation: installs the bundled DwoStateMonitor (prebuilt editor binaries + source) into Plugins/__DwoStateMonitor; editor/PIE only by default so packages are unaffected, --runtime keeps it in game targets; refuses removal while project code references it; migrates a dwo-Lens 1.x Plugins/__StateMonitor install
tools.output: runtime USTRUCT snapshots, change history, viewer; StateMonitor.* tests in verify

tools.invocation: unit tests, static checks, GUI build, full command cycle on an isolated project copy
BuildCookRun (Shipping) with dwo-Forge attached, package inspection, smoke run, detach

tools.description: Installs the bundled DwoCanvas plugin (prebuilt editor binaries + source) into Plugins/__DwoCanvas (git-excluded, like DwoStateMonitor); canvas-remove and uninstall delete it. Removal is refused while any asset still references DwoCanvasRuntime (--force overrides). A 2.0.0 install in Plugins/DwoCanvas is moved there automatically.
Checks a *.dwocanvas.json (dwocanvas/2) or legacy designbridge/1 file against the schema before importing.
Builds or incrementally updates Widget Blueprint designer trees from a design file; edits made in UE are kept unless --reset.
Install state, design file picker (drag and drop), validate / import / import with reset, and a summary of the latest import report.
